chunks: And through its chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him),
that he drank while standing and said, 'Thus I saw the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) do.'
ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad drink water while standing or sitting?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the continuity of prophetic practice (*sunnah*) through Imam Ali (a.s.), reinforcing the status of the Ahl al-Bayt as the living exemplars of the Prophet's conduct. By explicitly linking his action to the Prophet, the hadith underscores the theological principle that the Imams' actions are not merely personal preferences but divinely guided implementations of the Sunnah, a key concept in Shia jurisprudence and spirituality.
